name: pcbway
label: PCBWay standard PCB, 1 oz
notes: Limits of PCBWay's standard PCB service; PCBWay reviews the files before production.
0.3 mm is the order form's default minimum hole; smaller holes (from 0.15 mm) cost extra.
PCBWay does not publish a copper-to-edge value for standard boards; 0.3 mm is a conservative choice (its advanced service lists 0.25 mm).
